name: Taiheiyo Cement Corporation
summary: Taiheiyo Cement Corporation engages in the cement, mineral resources, environmental, construction materials, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, and internationally. Its Cement segment offers ordinary portland cement, specialty cement, soil stabilizers, and ready-mixed concrete. The Mineral Resources segment sells limestone aggregate products comprising course and fine aggregate used in ready-mixed concrete, and aggregate used in concrete products and civil engineering; sandstone and andesite as aggregate materials; quicklime, slaked lime, filler, silica, and silica powder; and hollow ceramics, sepiolite, wollastonite, and kaolin.
